description:
Use this when the user wants the details of one search result, or who to contact about it.

Pass the id from a search result. Returns the result's row plus its description (up to 2000 characters), published points of contact (name and title only) and, when MatchAwards has them, ai: AI-generated notes (subcontracting and large-prime angles) and a summary. AI text is AI-generated: label it as such whenever you quote it. Example: id="117402307943537453".

Print url, and sam_url for federal notices, as markdown links.

Do not use for searching (search_contracts, search_grants, search_jobs), for fit or bid/no-bid questions (assess_opportunity) or for contact details beyond the published names and titles.

id.description: The id field of a search result.
id.title: Id

name: get_opportunity

AiNotes.description: AI-generated notes MatchAwards wrote when it imported the notice. Every field is AI-generated text.
AiNotes.title: AiNotes

ai.description: AI-generated notes on this opportunity, or null. Label them as AI-generated when you show or quote them.

ai_matched_naics.description: Only when you filtered by naics: requested codes this contract notice matched only because MatchAwards' AI suggested them, not its own codes. Call such a match AI-suggested.
ai_matched_naics.title: Ai Matched Naics

contacts.description: Published points of contact; [] if none.
contacts.title: Contacts

id.description: Pass to get_opportunity for the description and contacts.
id.title: Id

matched_naics.description: Only when you filtered by naics: the requested codes this record carries: its own code (in naics) or, for a grant or job, another code of its program or occupation.
matched_naics.title: Matched Naics

naics.description: On state notices (type state) the naics code itself is AI-assigned.

no_fixed_deadline.description: true: the deadline is a placeholder date.
no_fixed_deadline.title: No Fixed Deadline

sam_url.description: The SAM.gov notice (federal only). Show it as a markdown link.
sam_url.title: Sam Url

url.description: The posting on matchawards.com. Show it as a markdown link.
url.title: Url

title: Get opportunity details
